composition_subtypes.role: Sort elements by value to group equal elements together
Assign colors in round-robin order based on sorted order to satisfy distinctness per color and cover all colors

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort elements by value to group equal ones, then assign colors in round-robin fashion to ensure no duplicate colors per value and all colors used at least once.
payload.rationale: The solution first sorts to group equal elements, then uses a greedy round-robin assignment to satisfy distinctness and coverage constraints.
